_help: A custom quest for the Quest Markers example. steps: places to go, in order, each { "text", "at": [x, y, z], "radius" (cm, default 400) }. In game, F9 (waypoint_key) adds one where your cat stands and logs the line to paste here (in UE4SS.log, as [QuestMarkers]). pickups: markers on pickups within pickup_range cm. debug_panel: your position, the camera and counts. toggle_key shows and hides it all.
title: A walk around camp
